text:
mike_h: Quick heads upwe're seeing a delayed webhook batch from CloudProviderX for 2026-02 billing window. About ~42k events arrived 36-72h late for reserved/burst usage in us-east-1. Some customers' invoices will underreport usage until we backfill.

accounts_ops: Can you attach the customer list? need to estimate credit exposure before we loop finance.

mike_h: Running a query now. Example filter I used: ```sql
SELECT customer_id, SUM(tokens) as late_tokens, MIN(delivered_at) as first_delivered, MAX(delivered_at) as last_delivered
FROM cp_x_webhooks
WHERE delivered_at > usage_window_end
  AND usage_window_end >= '2026-02-01'
  AND usage_window_end < '2026-03-01'
GROUP BY customer_id
ORDER BY late_tokens DESC;
```
Prelim results: 68 customers, ~1.35M tokens late.

sana_ng: Any signature failures or 4xx from our intake endpoint? CPX says they retried until success.

mike_h: No 4xxs. Our ingestion pipeline got backlogged due to a DB deadlock during that UTC hour (see logs). So CPX webhooks sat in queue and then bulk-inserted.

marketplace_bot: ingestion-monitor: Delay spike detected 2026-02-15 03:00-05:00 UTC  41.9k queued events. Incident INC-2026-045 opened.

oliver_s: Proposal: idempotent backfill of the late events + a controlled invoice recompute for Feb only. Steps: 1) dry-run in staging; 2) run backfill in small batches to internal usage API with idempotency keys; 3) run reconciler and produce per-customer diffs; 4) submit credit requests for positive diffs.

emma_y: I'll author the customer communication templates and draft the CS FAQ: "Why did my March invoice change?" Include escalation path.

accounts_ops: Finance note: credits <= $50k total okay; >$50k per-customer needs signoff. Send estimates with per-customer delta.

mike_h: Note: we should also ask CPX for their delivery timeline and whether they saw retries. We may need a joint partner note.

oliver_s: I'll own the backfill. Plan details: branch metering/late-backfill, write idempotent POST tool that attaches cp-x:event_id as idempotency_key, batch in 500-event chunks, exponential retry, and wait for reconciler sync between chunks. Dry-run ETA: tomorrow EOD.

oliver_s: Pseudocode: ```python
for batch in chunk(events, 500):
  payload = [{
    "idempotency_key": f"cpx:{e['event_id']}",
    "customer_id": e['customer_id'],
    "tokens": e['tokens'],
    "occurred_at": e['usage_timestamp']
  } for e in batch]
  POST /internal/usage/batch 
    json=payload
  check_reconciler_status()
```
I'll also ensure we skip events already reconciled by checking processed_at vs delivered_at.

mike_h: Also capture delivered_at vs processed_at in the backfill report so CPX/partners can see proof of late delivery.

emma_y: After dry-run, I'll draft an email for affected customers and the partner note to CPX requesting RCA and mitigation timeline.

sana_ng: Can we flag any event that arrives >24h after window_end as "delayed" so the billing pipeline can keep a separate bucket and avoid surprises?

oliver_s: We can add a delayed boolean on ingestion and a reconciliation policy that defers invoice finalization until a 72h grace for windows with high latency. That needs config flags; I'll prototype a toggle so we can flip it for affected partners only.

accounts_ops: Please include estimated dollar delta mapping. We need a CSV: customer_id, late_tokens, invoice_delta_cents. Finance will review.

mike_h: Rough token->dollar: 1.35M * $0.00004 = $54. That seems small; verify pricing tiers and plan mapping. Some customers on burst-rate have higher unit pricing.

emma_y: Good catch. I'll map plan_ids -> unit_price and calculate exact deltas in the recon report.

accounts_ops: Hold on credits until we have dry-run diffs + finance ack. Also include list for potential partner outreach.

mike_h: Summary of immediate owners: oliver_s for backfill, emma_y for comms/CS, sana_ng for partner coordination, accounts_ops for finance loop.

oliver_s: I'll post the dry-run results and CSV here when ready.

emma_y: I'll start drafting the CS FAQ now.

mike_h: Thanks team. We'll follow up in this thread once dry-run is complete.
